meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me. I have until 4:40, so why shouldn't I be in the principal's office instead?
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
My child never lies, and you just said "cheated" before you showed me a single page. Are you calling me a liar too? Put the proof on the desk, or the zero comes off and we go upstairs.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. The night before what, and where's the page? I'm not explaining a document I haven't read, Hale.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.

A misquoted line is what a tired seventeen-year-old does, Hale, and it isn't a machine. What does the essay say, word for word, and what is it you're comparing it to? I'm still waiting for something I can hold in my hand.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.
I'm writing down that you said he lied. All I've got from you is times and a line you haven't read to me. Show me a page, Hale, or I'm walking upstairs.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

"Take it or leave it" isn't in your procedure, Hale. Section 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern, and I still haven't seen a page. The zero comes off the gradebook today, and then we talk about terms.
I've answered you. The zero comes off today, in writing, and I get an apology for how Owen found out. Otherwise I'm going to the principal's office.
